Use dashboards to view pre-defined slices of data, or use the Explore features to investigate and dynamically filter/drill data. This tooling Grafana instance aggregates data from Loki and Prometheus across all environments. Use the environment-specific datasources to filter by account. ##### 📝 Configuration All dashboards, alerts, and configurations are defined via Terraform in the [infra repository](https://github.com/houserx/infra). ##### 🔰 Where to start New to Grafana or the LGTM stack? Check out available [tutorials](https://grafana.com/tutorials/). Otherwise, check out the existing dashboards or go exploring! ⬇️ --- ### 🕵️ Explore Metrics *[Explore Metrics](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/explore/simplified-exploration/metrics/) is a query-less experience for browsing Prometheus-compatible metrics. Quickly find related metrics with just a few simple clicks, without needing to write PromQL queries to retrieve metrics.*
Getting started 1. Start a [New metric exploration](https://grafana.tooling.houserx.io/explore/metrics), or load a previous one. 2. Select Your Data Source. - Start by choosing the relevant data source/environment from the dropdown in the top-left corner. 3. Add label(s) to filter by - Use key-value filters to refine your query. Common labels include `namespace`, `pod`, `service`, or `region`. - Example: `service = platform-api`, `region = us-east-2`, `namespace = platform` 4. Browse available metrics - Click into the metrics browser or use the auto-complete feature in the query editor to find metrics related to your service. - Look for meaningful prefixes (e.g., `http_`, `db_`, `k8s_`) to guide your search. 5. Visualize and Debug - Adjust the time range to zoom in on specific events. - Hover over graphs for detailed data points, and click to inspect related logs, if applicable. - Add or remove filters to isolate the metrics and resources you want to investigate.

### 🪵 Explore Logs *[Explore Logs](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/explore/simplified-exploration/metrics/) lets you automatically visualize and explore your logs without having to write queries.*
Getting started 1. To [start exploring logs](https://grafana.tooling.houserx.io/a/grafana-lokiexplore-app/), select Your Data source - From the dropdown, pick the logging data source (e.g., Loki). 2. Choose a service or label - Beneath the Data source, choose a service from the dropdown menu, add a custom label filter, or scroll down to view logs 3. Use filters and labels - Add more filters like `{service="example-service"}` or `{pod="example-pod"}` to narrow results. - Use regex or full-text search to find specific log messages or patterns. 4. Correlate with metrics & patterns - Use data from Metrics Explore to dive deeper into errors or slowness that correlate to logged calls - Check the Patterns tab for unusual repetitions of logging lines

### 🔥 Explore Profiles *[Explore Profiles](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/explore/simplified-exploration/profiles/) is a Grafana app designed to integrate seamlessly with [Pyroscope](https://pyroscope.io/), the open-source continuous profiling platform, providing a smooth, query-less experience for browsing and analyzing profiling data. Profiling is used to measure and analyze the runtime behavior of a program and its memory/CPU usage.* ‼️ Explore Profiles is in **public preview**.
Getting started 1. In [Explore Profiles](https://grafana.tooling.houserx.io/a/grafana-pyroscope-app/profiles-explorer) select each of the Exploration ovals, starting with "All services", to begin selecting and filtering data.
